messages:
alex_cs: Heads-up — we're planning a quota tier change for OrionHealth next week. Usage spiked 42% MoM and they're close to the soft cap. Need a short comms plan and technical confirmation by EOD Friday.

maria_csm: Thanks Alex. Quick summary: they use embeddings heavily for search, avg token/min up, latency steady, errors low. Risk: sudden throttling on weekend could break search UX.

alex_cs: Exactly. Proposal: 1) pre-notice email 72h before, 2) in-app banner 24h before, 3) targeted outbound from CSM if they hit 85% of new tier in 7 days. Agree?

tyler_se: Agree on comms. Tech note: current guardrail auto-throttle at 100 req/min. We can raise soft cap to 150 for them temporarily and keep hard cap at 300. Need approval for increasing their soft limit.

maria_csm: Approve temp soft cap 150 for 14 days. Will handle customer message and optional call. Can you add a rollback plan?

jamie_eng: Rollback plan: we set soft cap back to previous value and enable fallback routing to smaller model if latency spikes >200ms for 3 minutes. I'll add scripts to run the change automatically and monitor.

alex_cs: Perfect. Can we draft the short email + banner text here so Legal and Support can quickly scan?

maria_csm: Draft below — feel free to edit: 

```
Subject: Update to your usage tier and temporary capacity increase
Hi OrionHealth team,

We're adjusting quota thresholds for a small number of customers to keep services reliable as usage grows. For your account we've provisionally increased your soft request cap from 100 -> 150 for 14 days to avoid interruptions. No action required on your side.

If you expect sustained higher traffic, we can schedule a short call to discuss Dedicated or Reserved capacity options.

Thanks,
Redwood Customer Success
```

maria_csm: Banner suggestion: "Heads up: We're updating quota thresholds for some accounts to maintain performance. Learn more: <link>"

alex_cs: Nice. Tyler — can you confirm we can apply the soft cap change Friday 10:00 PST and that metrics will be emitted to the account dashboard? Also need an alert to @oncall if error rate exceeds 0.5% post-change.

.tyler_se: Confirmed — change can be applied Fri 10:00 PST. We'll emit account_metrics.request_rate, account_metrics.error_rate, account_metrics.avg_latency. I'll wire a PagerDuty alert for >0.5% errors for 5m.

jamie_eng: deploy-bot scheduled change job created: job/softcap-orionhealth-1803456789. Will run at Fri 10:00 PST, with automated rollback flag.

deploy-bot: job/softcap-orionhealth-1803456789 created by jamie_eng — scheduled for 2026-03-27T18:00:00Z — status: queued.

maria_csm: I'll queue Legal & Billing review now and follow up with an outbound note. If no blockers by Thu EOD, we'll send the 72h pre-notice Fri morning.

alex_cs: Great. Summary tasks: maria -> customer comm & legal check; tyler -> metrics + PD alert; jamie -> deploy job + rollback; alex -> coordinate with Support for in-app banner. Thanks team :thumbsup:

maria_csm: On it. Will post final email copy here once Legal signs off.

alex_cs: Closing loop — please update thread when Live or if any change.
